snippet.title: Pirates VR: Jolly Roger - Official Meta Quest Release Date Trailer | Upload VR Showcase Winter 2025
snippet.description: Pirates VR: Jolly Roger takes you on a once-in-a-lifetime adventure! With a parrot as a sidekick giving you the landlubbers’ tour, you’ll chase shiny treasures through beautiful, lush jungles, dark caves, and sunken ruins. As a pirate, you’ll also face some challenges, puzzles, and intense battles with cursed and malicious enemies. Make sure you watch your steps, as there are hidden traps and obstacles all around the place. Pirates VR: Jolly Roger will be available on Meta Quest 3 and Meta Quest 3s on January 29, 2026.
